question: For each year, calculate the percentage of films that had exclusively female actors (meaning no male actors and no actors with unknown/unspecified gender). Consider actors with gender marked as 'Male' or 'None' as non-female. For the results, display the year, the total number of movies in that year, and the percentage of movies with exclusively female actors. Extract the year from the Movie.year field by taking the last 4 characters and converting to a number.
sql:
-- Get full results
SELECT 
    year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_movies,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN non_female_count = 0 AND female_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS pct_exclusively_female
FROM (
    SELECT 
        mc.MID,
        mc.year,
        mc.title,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Female' THEN p.PID END) AS female_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Gender != 'Female' OR p.Gender IS NULL OR p.Gender = '' THEN p.PID END) AS non_female_count
    FROM (
        SELECT m.MID, CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS year, m.title
        FROM Movie m
        WHERE m.year IS NOT NULL AND m.year != ''
    ) mc
    JOIN M_Cast mcast ON mc.MID = mcast.MID
    JOIN Person p ON TRIM(mcast.PID) = p.PID
    GROUP BY mc.MID, mc.year, mc.title
) movie_gender_check
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

-- For each year, calculate percentage of movies with exclusively female actors
WITH movie_cast AS (
    SELECT 
        m.MID,
        CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        m.title
    FROM Movie m
    WHERE m.year IS NOT NULL AND m.year != ''
),
movie_gender_check AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.MID,
        mc.year,
        mc.title,
        -- Count of distinct female actors
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Female' THEN p.PID END) AS female_count,
        -- Count of distinct non-female actors (Male or empty/NULL)
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Gender != 'Female' OR p.Gender IS NULL OR p.Gender = '' THEN p.PID END) AS non_female_count
    FROM movie_cast mc
    JOIN M_Cast mcast ON mc.MID = mcast.MID
    JOIN Person p ON TRIM(mcast.PID) = p.PID
    GROUP BY mc.MID, mc.year, mc.title
)
SELECT 
    year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_movies,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN non_female_count = 0 AND female_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS pct_exclusively_female
FROM movie_gender_check
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
"}
